verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop app for working with a coding agent across your own projects. Per-chat model and effort settings imply that multiple agent chats exist inside the one app, and worktree creation hints at parallel work. Nothing explicitly documents a unified view for managing several concurrent sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-session management (session list, switching, monitoring parallel agents), worktree-per-session isolation tied to the workspace, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: omnirush.ai is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects.
Choose a model and an effort level (low, high, xhigh, max) per chat.
The agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests with `gh`.
